NewsArticle.Title: Server Maintenance
NewsArticle.Content: - 09.09 00:01 PDT Dark Ages servers shutdown for scheduled maintenance and returned to service after 5 minutes. During 99.09.09, herbs may only be found in the Enchanted Garden, and Nadurra (the elemental source) may not be found anywhere, due to quality assurance monitoring. It will return 99.09.11. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, [test your connection.](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm)
